properties.name: apex.messaging.consumer.concurrency
properties.description: Positive listener concurrency when consumer selected.

properties.name: apex.messaging.consumer.topics
properties.description: Comma-delimited distinct exact Kafka names; required for selected consumer. No wildcard/regex.

properties.name: apex.messaging.publisher.routing.required-contracts
properties.description: Contract keys required to appear in explicit route list.

properties.name: apex.messaging.publisher.routing.routes
properties.description: Explicit event-type/event-version/topic route list; required when routing selected.

properties.name: apex.messaging.consumer.enabled
properties.description: Select annotated consumer and Inbox. Requires topics and native Kafka group-id.

properties.name: apex.messaging.outbox.publisher.enabled
properties.description: Publisher selected only inside enabled messaging. Requires publisher.topic.

properties.name: apex.messaging.cell.enabled
properties.description: Select JDBC/Kafka messaging; owner provides datasource, serializers and migrations under db/platform.

properties.name: apex.messaging.publisher.topic
properties.description: One exact Kafka destination required when publisher selected; never inferred from event type.

properties.name: apex.messaging.outbox.publisher.interval-ms
properties.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds; must be positive when the publisher is selected.

properties.name: apex.messaging.storage.provider
properties.description: Storage selection: postgresql for legacy composition, custom for driver-free core. Custom requires owner storage beans; no fallback.
